title: SOFTWARE DEFINED SATELLITE AVIONICS DEVELOPMENT ENVIRONMENT (ARTES AT 4G.046) EXPRO+ RE-ISSUE (1-12222)
description: The objective of the activity is to produce a software development environment able to configure and build the full avionics software of a satcom using a model-based approachTargeted Improvements:- Reduction of up to 50% of the development time of the avionics system functions,- Enable one avionic platform to support many missions while being fully reconfigurable in flight.Description:The availability of System-on-Chip, powerful micro-controllers and reprogrammable FPGA enables a high-level of flexibility while improving the performance of avionic systems. However, this also multiplies the number of software components and hardware cores and their related interfaces. The development, verification and validation of such complex systems would benefit from a high-level of automation using a model-based approach. The benefits are particularly tangible at the level of interfaces as their automatic generationis not prone to error and thus enables a quicker development.This activity will build a model-based avionic development environment targeting a fully reconfigurable avionics platform for satcom, compliant to the SAVOIR (Space Avionics Open Interface Architecture) functional architecture. After analysing the variability of telecommunication spacecraft in term of data handling and functions, use cases will be identified, i.e. demonstration applications that will be used as support for the validation of the development environment. Then the software components will be selected as well as libraries, that will be supported including at least a Time and Space Partitioning kernel and/or a real-time operating system, a mathematical library, an interpreter, a command-and-control libraryand possibly an Artificial Intelligence model inference engine. A model-based software development environment supporting the modelling of the platform (definition of functions and their deployment on selected devices) will be developed, together with the configuration supporting the identified use cases and the generation of code for both software and hardware components and their integration.The target data handling system devices to be developed will be selected including at least a System-on-Chip, a multi-core processor, a reprogrammable FPGA and a micro-controller. Finally, the selected target system of the model-based development environment willbe tested.

da se ob upoštevanju potrebe po povečanju količin storitev iz predhodne alineje, upoštevajo dane izvajalčeve cene na enoto iz ponudbe po osnovni pogodbi, zaradi česar se pogodbena vrednost zviša, takšna sprememba pa je potrebna zaradi okoliščin, ki jih skrben naročnik sprva ni mogel predvideti in so se potrebe po povečanem obsegu storitev po predmetnem dodatku izkazale šele tekom izvajanja projekta, pri tem pa takšna sprememba ne spreminja splošne narave javnega naročila in je potrebna za uspešen zaključek projekta; da je naročnik tudi ugotovil, da so se potrebe storitve promocije, kot so bile opredeljene v poglavju 3 v dokumentu Tehnični del, številka: 43000-3/2022-2552-4 z dne 7.6.2022 (v nadaljevanju: Tehnični del), deloma spremenile, zaradi česar naročnik ugotavlja, da določenih promocijskih storitev oz. promocijskega gradiva ne bo potreboval (nakup brisač ter moških in ženskih softshell jaken), zaradi česar bo znotraj opisanih potreb po storitvah promocije namesto predvidenih naročilo drugo promocijsko gradivo (nakup teleskopskih pohodnih palic), ki sprva ni bilo izrecno opredeljeno v dokumentu Tehnični del, pri čemer pa se zaradi nadomestila enih storitev oz. gradiva z drugimi vrednost po pogodbi v tem delu ne spreminja (informativna vrednost nakupa teleskopskih pohodnih palic je tudi priloga predmetnega dodatka); da je naročnik ugotovil, da je potrebno s pogodbo urediti tudi določila glede poslovne skrivnosti, s katero se pogodbeni stranki srečujeta v okviru projekta, in prvotno to ni bilo določeno v osnovni pogodbi; da se predmetni dodatek sklepa tudi zaradi spremembe predstavnika naročnika za izvajanje pogodbe; da se ob upoštevanju vsega navedenega skladno z drugo, tretjo in peto točko prvega odstavka ter drugega odstavka 95. člena ZJN-3, sklepa predmetni Dodatek št. 2 k osnovni pogodbi, s katerim se poviša pogodbena vrednost po osnovni pogodbi zaradi povečanega obsega storitev iz Naloge 1: podporne naloge pri vodenju projekta, točka B: Storitev koordinacije ter Naloge 2: Storitve promocije, postavka Odnosi z javnostjo in mediji, Vsebinske konference, se dopolnijo oz. spremenijo zahteve v Tehničnem delu v poglavju 3 Storitve promocije, pri čemer se pogodbena vrednost v tem delu ne spreminja, saj bo naročnik naročal storitve in blago v okviru Storitev promocije glede na dejanske potrebe znotraj določene pogodbene vrednosti, se uredi določba glede poslovne skrivnosti in zamenja predstavnik naročnika; da predmet pogodbe sofinancirata Republika Slovenija in Evropska unija iz Sklada za okrevanje in odpornost. Sredstva za izvedbo pogodbe so zagotovljena na PP 221464 (C2K7IK Zeleni slovenski lokacijski okvir SGI-NOO-MOP-MNVP-GURS) in 321707 (Plačilo DDV za NOO-GURS) v okviru projekta 2550-22-0013 Zeleni slovenski lokacijski okvir. title: E4EX-006 MARS ADVANCED ENTRY, DESCENT AND LANDING CAPABILITY (MEDAL) - PHASE A
description: The next European mission to land on Mars will be the Rosalind Franklin Rover mission, which relies on non-European input for key elements on the entry, descent and landing module. The rover will enter on a ballistic entry with no additional means for precision landing. Increase in mass and precision of future Mars surface missions in the coming decades is a strategic capability for Europe, as outlined in the Explore2040 strategy implementation roadmap. To achieve this ambition, Europe must advance developments of guided entry landers and their associated technologies, avoiding technological dead ends as the capability progresses. The Mars surface lander that is the subject of this study will target a high precision landing (2-7 km major axis), which could be the first in a roadmap of increasingly precise and heavier landers, eventually aiming for a pinpoint landing accuracy of a few 10s of metres.The objectives of this activity are to:- demonstrate the technical and programmatic feasibility (Phase A) of the first mission thatwill utilise an advanced entry descent and landing capability on Mars. Advanced entry,decent and landing (EDL) is defined as a capability toland on Mars with a higher level ofmass, guidance and precision than will have been achieved in Europe following the landingof Rosalind Franklin and includes fully European critical technologies.- assess a sustainable roadmap of technology developments suitable for increased precisionand mass landings on Mars in future missions, to avoid technological gaps and dead ends.
